name: Smoldering Systemic Mastocytosis

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: WHO 2016 Diagnostic Criteria for Systemic Mastocytosis

criteria.description: Multifocal, dense infiltrates of mast cells (≥15 mast cells in aggregates) detected in bone marrow biopsies or other extracutaneous organs
More than 25% of mast cells in infiltrates are spindle-shaped or atypical
Detection of KIT codon 816 mutation in bone marrow or other extracutaneous organs
Expression of CD2 and/or CD25 on mast cells in bone marrow or other extracutaneous organs
Serum total tryptase persistently >20 ng/mL (unless associated with an associated hematologic neoplasm)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of the major criterion plus at least one minor criterion, or at least three minor criteria
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Smoldering systemic mastocytosis is characterized by a high mast cell burden without evidence of organ damage (C-findings) seen in aggressive systemic mastocytosis.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Cutaneous mast cell infiltrates with urticaria pigmentosa
searchTerms: clusters of mast cells in skin

pathognomonic.symptomName: Bone marrow mast cell aggregates with spindle-shaped morphology
searchTerms: abnormal mast cells in bone marrow

common.symptomName: Flushing episodes due to mast cell mediator release

searchTerms: intestinal cramps and frequent bowel movements

common.symptomName: Anaphylaxis triggered by insect stings or medications
searchTerms: severe allergic reaction to insect bites

common.symptomName: Fatigue related to mast cell mediator effects
searchTerms: extreme tiredness from mast cell effects
low energy due to mast cell activity

occasional.symptomName: Headaches and cognitive difficulties (mast cell mediator-related)
Abdominal pain unrelated to other gastrointestinal causes
searchTerms: stomach pain with no clear cause

occasional.symptomName: Mild hepatomegaly or splenomegaly without organ dysfunction

rare.symptomName: Anemia secondary to bone marrow involvement
searchTerms: low red blood cells from marrow disease
anemia due to bone marrow problems
low blood pressure not from allergy

laboratory: Bone marrow biopsy showing multifocal dense mast cell infiltrates
imaging: Bone densitometry showing osteopenia or osteoporosis
Ultrasound or CT showing mild hepatosplenomegaly
other: Flow cytometry showing aberrant expression of CD2 and/or CD25 on mast cells

distinguishingFeatures: Absence of B-findings seen in smoldering systemic mastocytosis
Presence of C-findings indicating organ damage
Lack of mast cell infiltration in bone marrow
Normal serum tryptase levels between episodes

redFlags: Signs of organ dysfunction (e.g., liver failure, malabsorption)
Severe anaphylactic reactions requiring emergency intervention
references: Valent P, et al. Diagnosis and treatment of systemic mastocytosis: 2021 update. Leukemia. 2021.
Horny HP, et al. Mastocytosis: pathology and genetics. Hematol Oncol Clin North Am. 2014.
